## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Protect the `gh-aw` canonical session capture from agent tools by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10606
* Add multimodal notes to `AskUserAnswer` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11664
* Count `BrowserUse` model calls toward the host run's usage and `UsageLimits` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11860
* Name the V2 replacement when code imports a name V2 removed, like `OpenAIModel` or `MCPServerStdio` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12035
* Fall back to the next model in `ModelFallback` when a model refuses, and let `ContentFilterError` in `fallback_on` match refusals by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12039
* Raise `ModelQuotaExceededError` instead of `ModelRateLimitError` for Z.ai balance and plan-limit 429s by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12042
* Support the `'12h'` prompt cache retention on the OpenAI Responses API for GPT-5.6 and later by @DouweM
